research_question: Can frozen, ground-truth-free descriptor-map statistics predict the sign/direction of the benefit of a specified aggregator relative to equal_mean for unseen images?

hypotheses.preoutcome_feature: mean of pairwise Pearson correlations between three descriptor score maps

measures.score: F1 with native-ground-truth-geometry one-to-one maximal-cardinality matcher; do not substitute official Berkeley metrics
measures.comparison: delta_F1(candidate)-delta_F1(equal_mean) is shorthand; actual outcome is F1(candidate)-F1(equal_mean) on the same image and fixed evaluator
measures.postprocessing: NMS; suppression identity; legacy_sigmoid calibration; identical interface between candidate and control
measures.threshold_selection: training/calibration cohort only; parameter values and code SHA frozen before opening confirmatory GT
measures.repeats: If folds/repetitions are used, average per original image before analysis. No pseudoreplication
measures.VSB100_GT_policy: General full-resolution MAT groundTruth[4].Boundaries; uint8 exact {0,1}; native geometry; four separate F1 values averaged per image; no union, no GT rescale, no segmentation-derived replacement
measures.NYUD_GT_policy: Authors supplied ECCV14 benchmarkData groundTruth.Boundaries, one uint8 exact0/1 mask, native425x560; no reconstruction from labels, no GT resizing, no posthoc ignore mask; custom full-raster paired F1, not official NYUD benchmark
measures.cache_policy: Persist the four float32 native descriptor arrays and four boolean H1/H2 predictions per image in NPZ; bind NPZ SHA256 and C-order array SHA256/shape/dtype in checkpoint; verify on every reuse
measures.BIPED_secondary_GT_provenance: SHA256 of each exact local PNG pinned by opaque byte hashing before freeze, without decoding pixels; verify digest before PNG decoding
measures.NYUD_RGB_provenance: Authors ECCV14 supplied PNGs retained unchanged. Independent verification:151/153 pixel-exact to official HDF RGB crop[45:470,40:600]; img6258 and img5636 differ only in localized face regions (860 and3036pixels), with all exterior pixels identical. Appearance compatible with supplied face blurring is an inference, not officially documented here. Do not substitute HDF RGB, modify GT, or invent ignore masks.

cohort.eligibility: Primary: independently reviewed scene/capture/video in each of three domains with at least60units; BIPED below60 after exposure audit is secondary only
cohort.selection: All retained independent scene representatives fixed from RGB-only audits; one representative per connected scene component by minimum source SHA256; NYUD153 official-test room representatives selected before any GT outcomes; VSB one annotated frame per video selected by hashed names before RGB inspection
cohort.exclusion: Whole historical or unresolved scene components excluded; reserved training-format scenes and clearly animated VSB videos excluded; independent review covers all primary and secondary identities
cohort.power_analysis: 10000 synthetic replicates per scenario and 100000 reusable rank-null draws; 0.20 homogeneous within-domain Spearman target fixed, report heterogeneous sensitivity separately

inference.test: one-sided within-domain outcome permutation, 100000 draws per H1/H2
inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down across the two primary p-values
inference.ties: midranks; permute outcomes only within the three fixed domains
inference.uncertainty: image-level stratified bootstrap 95% CI for rho; inference remains Holm permutation p values
inference.missing_data: Abort the whole locked run for any invalid/missing GT/map; no row removal or replacement on seeing GT; deviations separately documented and reviewed before any changed analysis
inference.effect_size_report: rho, 95% CI, unadjusted and Holm-adjusted p; per-domain diagnostics
inference.secondary_analysis: Domain-specific rho and influence analysis as exploratory, not additional primary tests
inference.primary_statistic: Weighted mean of domain-specific tied-midrank Spearman correlations; weights n_d-1
inference.primary_population: Only prospectively labelled primary rows from MultiCue/NYUDv2/VSB100; BIPED contributes zero rows to primary statistics and p-values
inference.secondary_BIPED: Fixed BIPED48 list; descriptive per-domain Spearman and mean pairedF1delta only; no primary confirmation claim or added confirmatory p-values; undefined secondary rho is reported null without changing primary rows

adaptive_selector.gate: Only propose evaluation after H1/H2 confirmatory analysis; separate held-out set never used to choose features, operators or hyperparameters
adaptive_selector.comparator: best fixed operator selected on training data, selected single descriptor, equal_mean
adaptive_selector.evaluation: pre-locked paired image-level comparison and CI entirely on untouched test data; oracle is only a ceiling

freeze_requirements: Complete and adjudicate all VSB100 RGB historical/within-cohort flags
Review three-domain scope, min-domain change, exact sample and power assumptions independently
Pin all scientific code, recipe, original image and annotation archive hashes
Independently approve GT semantics, lineage, executor, analysis and protocol
Create distinct prospective freeze commit before first candidate GT or outcome access

prospective_amendment.reason: Independent RGB review invalidated additional BIPED scenes and historical overlaps, leaving only 48 eligible candidate units; original per-primary-domain minimum60 preserved
changed: Primary domains are MultiCue, NYUDv2 unseen rooms, and VSB100 unseen video scenes
BIPED48 is prospectively secondary exploratory only, excluded from primary N and Holm tests
Primary target312 and total evaluation360, subject to final supplemental RGB screening and independent review
unchanged: H1/H2 identities, directional predictions, descriptors, operators and equal_mean controls
Exact P1 recipe and thresholds; no fitting on new source
One-to-one matching, tolerance .0075 native diagonal, no GT resize
Within-domain rank statistic weights n_d-1, 100000 permutations, one-sided Holm family .05
prospective_amendment.scope_limitation: VSB100 measures perceptual segmentation boundaries, not dense low-level edges; domain-specific diagnostics and sensitivity must be reported.
prospective_amendment.NYUD_scope: NYUD family was represented in UDED development; new physical room scenes are the operational units, not a globally unseen source family; dwelling-level IDs unavailable
prospective_amendment.VSB_scope: No previous VSB100 use found in inspected tracked repository; this does not prove absence of undocumented use

MultiCue.annotation: six separate edges PNGs, uint16 exact0/65535

NYUDv2.novelty_unit: unseen room scene, not globally unseen family or independently identified household

VSB100.search_scope: inspected tracked repository and original local audit records
VSB100.RGB_release: official Train.zip/Test.zip ranged extraction with ETag, centraldirectorySHA, memberCRC, and selectedPNG SHA
VSB100.annotation_archives: General_train_fullres.zip and General_test_fullres.zip, exact per-row archiveSHA

BIPED_secondary.source: original BIPEDv2 train RGB and provided GT PNG; protected localGT only opaquely hashed before freeze
